::: {#sol-degree-sum}

From @fig-office, the counts are

| Computer | $a$ | $b$ | $c$ | $d$ | $e$ | $f$ |
|:--------:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Cables   | 2   | 3   | 3   | 3   | 3   | 2   |

and their sum is $2 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 2 = 16$.
That is twice the number of cables, 8,
since each cable has two ends and is counted once at each.

:::
